visualCharacteristics.purpose: Tabbed finder band (e.g. Find a doctor / Find a location) with an authorable panel per tab
visualCharacteristics.description: White band. Two large text tabs ("Find a doctor" active with blue underline, "Find a location") spanning the content width; below, a provider search form: keyword input, Insurance dropdown, Near (required) location dropdown, blue Search button.

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, one row per tab: cell 1 = tab label, cell 2 = panel content (text and a link to the finder app, e.g. /doctors or /locations)

usage: Self-contained tabs inside one block (unlike `tabs`, which groups sections). Accessible tablist with arrow/Home/End keys. The source provider-search form is a third-party app; panels hold an authorable link to it.
reuseGuidance: Use for small in-block tab sets with short panel content. For tabs that wrap whole sections use `tabs`.
